lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The columns align with the body's vertical ridges, with the spots increasing in diameter and spacing toward the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (ridges) intersect with horizontal planes of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where the highest-intensity blobs are positioned as nodes upon the vertical ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-value pixels on the dorsal edge and low-value shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, vertically-banded fish (commensal) positioned near the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
